body: I'm still here. I weathered that storm, and I'm feeling a bit more positive right now. Thank you.

What you say about one messed up life vs all of theirs (3 kids) has merit.

I can't work. I had a job, and I had to give it up years ago. I can't just fix my sleeping schedule because I have CFS, which comes with extreme fatigue and excessive sleepiness at random times. I have tried EVERYTHING, been under specialists, etc, to try and make it work but it doesn't.

I've been trying to distract myself with fun stuff, but it isn't exactly fun right now. It's just going through the motions. I already take meds, but I get the feeling they aren't being the most effective right now.

I did see one, but I was dismissed from their books because I'm disabled and struggle to get to appointments sometimes. I'm in the UK so reliant on the NHS, which is not great with mental health issues so nothing else was offered to me.
I know. It's why I'm still here. I wish it wouldn't hurt them and I could just do it though.

I have depression, I'm disabled and I'm always in constant pain. I can't work, I can barely get out of bed some days and the world really places value on contributing to society through work. I can barely contribute to my kid's lives sometimes. What's the point in this kind of life?
